chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2024
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup quarter-final, in Tashkent. Ukraine play Venezuela. Defender Mykola Mykytiuk scores the ninth goal. Ukraine win nine four, on the way to a bronze medal!

chapters.label: How he defends
chapters.text: This is how he defends: he stays close behind the pivot. The pass comes. The pivot tries to turn, but he slides across. Again, blocked! Then he pokes it away and goes!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Stay close, slide across, keep him in front, poke it away!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the attacker in front of you, and don’t let them turn!
